sampling: uniform-progress: frame i sits at progress i/(frames-1) along the path, at constant speed inside each segment and matched speed across joins; the player maps time to progress with the easing

easing.velocity: cubic smoothstep ramps over the first 15 % and the last 30 % of play_s, constant between
easing.reverse: the same frames played from last to first with the same curve in time

mobile.rule: full-height 3:5 window, centre moves linearly in progress (eased in time)

first_frame: D1: identical to the master at this size
last_frame: D2: identical to the master at this size

segments.source: code: pan_reproject.py, masters mode (D1 recipe-v5 draft -> D2-r2 draft registered to its clay)

swap.rule: the player cross-fades from the composed room (current variants) to frame 1, and from the last frame to the composed room; footage is rendered with the default products

note: TEST on Phase-B drafts (recipe-v5), not v7 masters; D2-r2 registered to its clay (-24 px); mobile windows are proposals (D1 0.33, D2 0.50)
